title: Beacon: three-year deal terms

sentences.speaker: Khalid Mansour
sentences.text: Our listeners notice immediately when an Arabic voice sounds like a textbook.

sentences.speaker: Dana Whitaker
sentences.text: Which dialect matters most for you?

sentences.speaker: Khalid Mansour
sentences.text: Gulf dialect for features, and clean Modern Standard Arabic for news bulletins.

sentences.speaker: Fatima Al-Rashid
sentences.text: We have put both voices into the draft contract as a delivery condition, due end of February.

sentences.speaker: Dana Whitaker
sentences.text: I'll confirm feasibility with the voice team before we countersign.

sentences.speaker: Fatima Al-Rashid
sentences.text: If those voices are not live by the twenty-eighth of February we have an exit clause.

summary: Beacon's three-year deal is conditional on Modern Standard and Gulf-dialect Arabic voices by 28 Feb 2027, with an exit clause.
action_items: Dana to confirm feasibility with voice team
